notes: Pooled-direction results and exact unrounded counts/rates for every year, window and preceding-leg cohort are included in CSVs. Displayed rates retain six decimals before formatting.
Continuation uses candle colour; F1 recovery uses its close relative to R.close. A gap can make these outcomes differ.

sections.body: R is the first completed non-doji candle directly after a completed opposite-colour candle. A bullish R follows a bearish leg; a bearish R follows a bullish leg. n counts additional candles after R: preceding bearish,bearish,bearish → bullish R → bullish F1 → bullish F2 is a 3-candle preceding leg and a success at n=2. Known preceding lengths use the whole observed leg; unknown starts have their own group. All preceding legs includes every reversal, including unknown starts. Choose year, session and preceding leg in the tables. All years + All hours gives overall; a year + All hours gives yearly; All years + a named window gives session; a year + a window gives year-by-session. The All preceding legs row overlaps the disjoint size rows; do not sum it with them. F1 is the immediate next completed candle. Retracement is a touch of 25%, 50%, 75% or 100% of R's body from its close toward its open; equality counts. A favorable close is strictly beyond R.close in R's direction. 100% reaches R.open, rather than the outer wick. Joint rate = touch AND favorable / known F1; conditional rate = touch AND favorable / touched F1. These answer different questions. OHLC establishes a touch and final close, without resolving the full intrabar path or a tradable fill.

sections.body: Event groups use R's completion proxy (when the signal becomes known), rather than its opening or outcome time. Year uses its inferred 18:00-rollover session date. Follow-up continues across named-window endpoints but never across inferred daily sessions or completion barriers. NY wall-time windows: Asia 20:00–02:00; London 02:00–09:00; NY 09:30–16:00; Asia Open 19:30–21:30; NY Open 09:30–10:30; NY AM 10:30–12:30; NY PM 12:30–16:00. Start included, end excluded. Overlapping windows cannot all be summed. 2019 and 2026 have partial coverage. The entire partial final session 2026-09-24 is excluded. Bar coverage is anchored at bar opening, separately from event completion-time groups. Original same-second and identical rows retain source order. OHLC is available; volume, exact completion and contract/roll treatment are unverified. These are descriptive historical frequencies on already-inspected history, without independent forecast validation, iid confidence intervals or trading profitability evidence.
